units.source_text: 女人像条死了心的狗，毫无反抗地耷拉着脑袋。

en.t: The woman hung her head without the slightest resistance, like a dog whose spirit had died.

units.source_text: 男人就是当她面吞下氰酸钾，她一定也会这样默默不语地瞧着。

en.t: Even if the man swallowed potassium cyanide right in front of her, she would surely just watch in the same silent way.
